type Solution = static class

fn CountByParity(nums: List<int>) -> Dictionary<string, int>
    let counts: Dictionary<string, int> = Dictionary<string, int>()
    counts.Add("Even", 0)

            counts["Even"] += 1
        else
            counts["Odd"] += 1
    return counts

type Product = record(string Name, string Category, decimal Price, int Quantity)

type Solution = record()

fn TotalByCategory(products: IEnumerable<Product>) -> Dictionary<string, decimal>
    let totals: Dictionary<string, decimal> = Dictionary<string, decimal>()
    for p in products
        totals[p.Category] = totals[p.Category] == 0.0 ? p.Price * p.Quantity : totals[p.Category] + p.Price * p.Quantity
    return totals

fn CheapestInCategory(products: IEnumerable<Product> products, string category) -> Product?
    let inCat = products |> filter(p => p.Category == category)
    if len(inCat) == 0
        return null
    return min_by(inCat, p => p.Price)

static class Solution
    public static List<int> PrimeFactors(int n)
        let out: List<int> = []
        let mut x = n
        let mut p = 2
        while p * p <= x
            if x % p == 0
                while x % p == 0
                    push(out, p)
                    x /= p
            p += 1
        if x > 1
            push(out, x)
        return out

    if n < 2

type Solution = static class

fn sieve_of_eratosthenes(limit: int) -> list<int>
    let out: list<int> = []
    if limit < 2
        return out
    let mut i = 2
    while i <= limit
        if not (has(out, i))
            push(out, i)
            let mut j = 2
            while j * i <= limit
                if has(out, j * i)
                    out.RemoveAt(j * i)
                j += 1
        i += 1
    return out

fn CountPrimes(limit: int) -> int
    return sieve_of_eratosthenes(limit) |> len

static class Solution
    public static int[] PrimeFactors(int n)
        let out: list<int> = []
        let mut x = abs(n)
        let mut d = 2
        while d * d <= x
            if x % d == 0

                    x /= d
            d += 1
        if x > 1
            push(out, x)
        return out.ToArray()

static class Solution
    public static int BinarySearch(int[] sorted, int target)
    {
        let mut low = 0
        let mut high = len(sorted) - 1
        while low <= high
        {
            let mid = (low + high) / 2
            if sorted[mid] == target
                return mid
            elif sorted[mid] < target
                low = mid + 1
            else
                high = mid - 1
        }
        return -1
